description.value: Big Splash Water Slide Park is a seasonal outdoor water park in Tsawwassen featuring over a dozen body and tube slides for all skill levels, a kids splash zone, family and adults-only hot tubs, beach volleyball, basketball, and multiple on-site eateries and a licensed sports bar. Ranked #1 among BC waterparks by several media outlets and rated among North America's most affordable, it draws families from across the Lower Mainland. Notably, the park offers a complimentary shuttle from the Tsawwassen Ferry Terminal, making it a natural stop for cyclists arriving via BC Ferries.

address.value: 4775 Nulelum Way, Tsawwassen, British Columbia V4M 4G9

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website provides detailed facility information for this operating seasonal water park in Tsawwassen. Washrooms are confirmed via 'Full Change Room facilities with baby change tables' on the guest-services page; food is confirmed via three named eateries (Big Splash Grill, AJ's Pizza Joint, BV Bar/Sports Bar, Candy Cafe); Wi-Fi is confirmed as 'Free Wifi'; and lockers are explicitly listed as a rental item. No mention of bike parking, bike-specific amenities, water bottle refill stations, or showers (change rooms are confirmed but showers are not explicitly stated).
concerns: OSM record is extremely sparse: no osm_id, no address, no phone, no tags — essentially a stub entry. Address, phone, and contact details sourced entirely from the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating, publicly accessible attraction with an active 2026 season (June 27–September 7, 2026) confirmed on the website. Relevant to touring cyclists especially those using the Tsawwassen Ferry terminal.
enrichment_extras.notes: Park offers a complimentary 32-passenger shuttle from the Tsawwassen Ferry Terminal, which may be relevant to cyclists arriving by ferry on the vancouver-crossing-loop route. Outside food and alcohol are explicitly prohibited on park premises.

Café or food on site.detail: Three eateries listed: Big Splash Grill (burgers, hot dogs, fish and chips, poutine), AJ's Pizza Joint, BV's Sports Bar (fully licensed), and Candy Cafe

Luggage / bag storage.detail: Keyed lockers available for rental on-site; listed under Equipment on guest-services page and hours-map page
